attributes.name: ypy-progress
attributes.description: Shows the progress bar for the requests of this element or region, not only for navigations. `false` hides it for them.

values.name: false
values.description: No bar for the requests of this element or region.

config.name: progress.delay
config.description: Milliseconds a request waits before the bar shows.

config.name: progress.all
config.description: Show the bar for every request, not only navigations and elements with `ypy-progress`.

config.name: progress.label
config.description: The accessible name of the bar.

elements.name: ypy-progress-bar
elements.description: The progress bar: one element appended to `<html>` while a navigation waits, a shadow root host with its own adopted stylesheet. Theme it with the `--ypy-progress-*` variables on `:root`.
